meta_description:
345K likes, 1,727 comments - vogueindia on October 28, 2026: "Katrina Kaif (@katrinakaif) has spent the better part of two decades raising a generation of baddies. She’s now enjoying a life that doesn’t need to revolve around the screen. Returning to the cover of Vogue India after eight years, the actor-entrepreneur talks about making peace with things she can’t control and why the public’s opinions about her body aren’t her problem to solve.

Read the full cover story at the link in bio.
